question: Will Manchester United beat Hull City in their Premier League match on Saturday 22 August 2026 (result after 90 minutes + stoppage time)?

- "No": Wins if Hull City's score is strictly greater than Manchester United's score at full time (90 minutes plus stoppage time) of the Premier League match on 22 August 2026.
- "Draw": Wins if both teams have an equal score at full time (90 minutes plus stoppage time) of the Premier League match on 22 August 2026.
